description: This file defines a service class 'WorkflowsOutputService' responsible for mapping workflow data objects to their DTO representations for different workflow types ('routing-form' and 'event-type'). It includes methods for mapping steps, checking trigger types, and converting workflow entities to output DTOs, with extensive use of imported DTOs, constants, and enums related to workflows.

classes.name: WorkflowsOutputService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to map workflow entities to their respective output DTOs for different workflow types, and includes internal helper methods for trigger and action validation.

methods.name: _isFormAllowedStepAction
methods.description: Checks if a given step action is allowed as a form step action based on predefined allowed actions.

methods.name: _isFormAllowedTrigger
methods.description: Checks if a given trigger is an allowed form trigger based on predefined trigger types.

methods.name: _isOffsetTrigger
methods.description: Checks if a trigger is an offset trigger based on predefined offset trigger types.

methods.name: mapStep
methods.description: Maps a workflow step entity to its corresponding DTO, either for 'event-type' or 'routing-form' based on discriminator.

methods.name: toRoutingFormOutputDto
methods.description: Converts a workflow entity of type 'ROUTING_FORM' into its DTO representation if trigger is allowed.

methods.name: toEventTypeOutputDto
methods.description: Converts a workflow entity of type 'EVENT_TYPE' into its DTO representation if trigger is not a form trigger.
